title: A false plain `constraint` and a violated `require` are two refutations and exit 1, never `axioms inconsistent`
note: A plain `constraint` states a claim, not a fact: read as an axiom it would make the context contradictory and every obligation in the run undecided, so a model with two plain faults would report nothing wrong with either of them. Paired with literal-two-refutations, which must agree.
